title: Hospital Staffing Transfer Shift Heatmap
goal: Build a standalone D3 dashboard that shows hourly hospital staffing gaps as a weekday-by-shift heatmap with tooltips, plus a synchronized unit-level trend panel for the selected cell or row.
skillBenefitRationale: This transfers the same shipped skill into a matrix-based temporal dashboard, requiring D3 scales, axes, color encoding, data joins, and coordinated interaction without relying on any non-D3 specialty skill.
